update_mir_test_checks: update MIR test files by auto-generating FileCheck patterns from llc output
run_update_test_file: run update_test_file on a MIR test to regenerate FileCheck checks for all functions
build_run_list: build a list of RUN lines from a test file extracting llc commands and FileCheck prefixes
find_functions_with_one_bb: find functions in MIR that have exactly one basic block for simplified checking
add_check_lines: add FileCheck lines for a function body with virtual register name mangling
